surface.name: gully-across
surface.label: Graduation Peak: across the gullies
surface.blurb: Real ground, from the Kachemak Bay 2023 lidar, below Graduation Peak: corner to corner across the patch, from 20 m in from the north-west corner to 20 m in from the south-east one (made up), 31 m of climb in 386 m (8 %), across two incised gullies whose walls are 80-120 %. There is no formula here: the straight line is the comparison.
